title: A.I. Fueled Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s Elite Status, but Scandal Followed
summary: As chips became essential components for A.I., executives like Nvidia’s Jensen Huang saw their personal wealth and profiles soar in a way the industry has not experienced before.
